# MambaHR

> MambaHR is the AI HR department for US companies. Instead of adding HR headcount as you scale, the agent runs the operational work — hiring, onboarding, leave, performance, compensation, and compliance — end to end, and routes only the judgment calls to a human.

## What MambaHR actually is

MambaHR is a standalone web app at app.mambahr.com. It is the system of record: HRIS + ATS + LMS in one. Not a Slack bot. Not a chatbot. Not an add-on to another HRIS. A coordinated set of specialist agents does the operational HR work, with a single human-in-the-loop policy screen for the calls that matter.

## Who it's for

- US companies, 2 to 500+ employees
- Heads of People, CHROs, Chief People Officers replacing legacy HRIS stacks (Workday, Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Namely, HiBob, ADP, Deel)
- Founders running HR off Notion docs and spreadsheets
- Lean people teams that want to grow the company without growing HR headcount

## What makes MambaHR different

- **Agents do the work, not just notify.** Where competing tools surface a question or generate a draft, MambaHR's agent reads the policy, checks eligibility, drafts paperwork, files records, notifies stakeholders, and writes the audit trail. End to end.
- **Federal + 50-state employment law, cited on every decision.** Compliance is reasoned about, not just stored. FMLA × state paid-leave stacking, multi-state pay transparency, exempt classification — all handled, with the rule cited.
- **Always-you safety.** Terminations, RIFs, separation agreements, offers above band, and comp changes above your threshold are always routed to a human. Never automated.
- **Payroll-ready exports.** MambaHR generates the per-cycle change file in your payroll provider's format (ADP, Workday, Gusto, Rippling, and others); you upload it. MambaHR does not run payroll.
- **Hiring intelligence is advisory.** Candidate and internal-mobility matching is advisory only — a human makes every hiring decision.
- **1-day setup.** Imports from any HRIS in a day. Live the next morning. No 4-to-8-week deployment.
- **One screen of policy.** Approval thresholds, leave rules, comp ranges, sign-off gates — configured on a single page. Edit anytime.

## Positioning vs incumbents

- vs Rippling — Rippling is the stack. MambaHR is the department that runs on it.
- vs Gusto — Gusto handles payday. MambaHR handles every other day.
- vs BambooHR — BambooHR is a database. MambaHR is the department.
- vs Workday — Workday is a project. MambaHR is a product.
- vs Deel — Deel pays global contractors. MambaHR runs your domestic HR.
- vs HiBob — HiBob made HR look modern. MambaHR makes it run itself.
- vs ADP — ADP is the back office. MambaHR is the front line.
- vs Namely — Namely made the HRIS prettier. MambaHR makes it unnecessary.

## Pricing

From $14 per employee / month, billed annually ($10k/yr minimum). See https://mambahr.com/pricing.
